title: So fun! Do it!!
text: Santiago was amazing!! The places we visited were fun. The food was good. The drinks were so good!  They accommodate food allergies and you don't feel singled out. Also learned some history.  I would do it again.  So fun!
author: shenieces2021

title: It's worth every penny. But I don't recommend bringing children
text: Very good experience. Opportunity to meet people of different nationalities and cultures.  The tour was great and the restaurants deserve congratulations!
author: 777eunices

title: Great time with our guide...
text: Great time with our guide Sevi. The food and drinks alone are worth more than the price. Securities was also great at giving us some history background at places we were visiting and cool to hang out with diverse travelers
author: Alex_K

title: Walking, Wine and Food Experience
text:
We did the Barcelona Tapas walking tour to get a feel of the city before our cruise.  Our tour guide Andrew was wonderful. It was a small friendly group.  The restaurants had different menu options, so we got to try a lot of different foods. I know to skip the snails.  We went to their kitchen for one of their chefs to cook shrimp dish for us.  We ended the tour at Kulas by the waterfront. The bartender was fun to hang out with, we drank so much there. Nice night spot. 
Andrew provided info on other places to try while in Barcelona.  We enjoyed the tour so much, we booked a cooking class with
author: U2841KPmarcial

title: Nice variety
text:
We had a very nice variety of tapas at four places we would never know to stop on our own.  Drink was plentiful and again everything was different.  Made our own sangria to end the night. 
Siobhan was an excellent host.
author: Kristi_B

title: Recommended
text: Great fun with some interesting stories and a lovely variety of tapas and drinks. Siobhan was a lovely guide
author: Aidan_M

title: Fun friends trip
text: We had so much fun. Lots to eat and drink. One of the best food tours we’ve been on. Plenty of time to enjoy the food and visit with fellow tourists - well worth the price.
author: Cindy_M

title: Fun Night Tour with a little history
text: Our guide was great! Great experience overall! It was great to try 4 different places and not have to think about where to go or what to plan for the night.
author: Nicolas_F

title: Fantastic food tour! Best...
text: Fantastic food tour! Best of the 4 we have taken this month. Lots of great food, good drinks. We highly recommend this tour.
author: Jane_K
